research_notes: Blocked for headline calculation: full-time evidence exists for later excluded union/nonprofit roles; TAB/NEC/HBA hours and historical employer classification remain missing.
Primary employer history verifies 1994 TAB privatisation. Do not classify entire 1990–1996 interval from present ownership. No exact conversion/split invented.

HESTA is governed by a nonprofit corporate trustee; a public company is not the public sector. Aggregator must retain the nonprofit exclusion unless the codebook explicitly changes institutional treatment.
Official, member, employer governance and contemporary interview sources reviewed. Exact dates establish tenure, not automatically full-time employment for early roles.

Follow-up2026-10-02: resolved HBA historical private commercial classification using1997 Industry Commission and2000 ACCC records; employer1995 report gives TAB privatisation/listing15 August1994. Unknown historical HBA classification in earlier notes is superseded by this evidence.

Recorded1995 two-month absence and casual call-centre status without inventing absence dates or extrapolating casual status to six years. Added music activity with remuneration unknown. Member also mentions several early jobs, still unidentified.

Follow-up2026-10-03: recovered the current first-speech transcript after the obsolete nested URL returned404. Added the previously omitted first after-school job and occasional bit-part acting, refined the ACTU role sequence, and recorded the mid-February HESTA goodbye against the official5 April cessation date without guessing leave or contract arrangements.

Next leads: TAB/NEC/HBA employment hours and any changed contracts; exact absence and payroll-transfer boundaries; names and dates for early jobs/acting and whether music was paid; HESTA campaign leave or contractual cessation evidence. Historical sector resolution does not establish headline years.

Fourth follow-up4October2026: primary/near-contemporaneous music records now resolve two previously unnamed bands: The Late Mail and The Beautiful Few. The Late Mail's own recording credits place Doyle as vocalist on material planned for a1996 second album, while arts coverage names her in The Beautiful Few's EP lineup. These are point-in-time creative-work observations, not proof of remuneration, continuous tenure or full-time hours. HBA/TAB/NEC and acting searches produced no contract or work-status evidence; unrelated same-name performers were rejected.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Added three official qualifications and three professional-profile certifications. Victoria University2002 institution attendance distinguished from unknown qualification conferral; RG146 issue months not treated as course starts. Employer/hour searches for TAB, NEC and HBA found no member-specific contracts or work fractions. American performers/students, Irish namesakes and New Zealand retirement facilities rejected; other people full-time statements not imported. Existing casual TAB episode, illness absence, music, acting and HESTA cessation conflict remain. Next contracts/leave records and institution qualification confirmation.

Fifth follow-up 5 October 2026: recovered primary PM-hosted personal transcript naming previously omitted checkout-operator and cleaner work; added undated unknown-employer spells without assuming these are distinct from or concurrent with the residual first after-school job. It independently corroborates present-tense full-time work in February 2023, not the hours of earlier TAB/NEC/HBA or performance jobs. Both-engine early employer, HESTA leave and legal payroll searches returned no original contract, leave record or safer entity allocation; New Zealand retirement facilities and overseas candidates/actors were rejected. HESTA actual-work departure versus official contract end remains explicit; TAB privatisation, casual illness episode and music/acting pay remain unresolved. Next dated personal CV or publicly available employer records; no numerical headline change.
